38.text: Jesus turned and saw them following. “What do you want?” He asked. They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”

39.text: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.

42.text: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter). Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

43.text: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, “Follow Me.”

47.text: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”

48.text: “How do You know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”

50.text: Jesus said to him, “Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these.”

51.text: Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

4.text: “Woman, what is that to you and to Me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”

7.text: Jesus told the servants, “Fill the jars with water.” So they filled them to the brim.

8.text: “Now draw some out,” He said, “and take it to the master of the banquet.” They did so,

16.text: To those selling doves He said, “Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!”

19.text: Jesus answered, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.”

3.text: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again. ”

5.text: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.

6.text: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.

7.text: Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’

8.text: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”

10.text: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?

11.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.

12.text: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?

13.text: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven— the Son of Man.

14.text: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

15.text: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.

16.text: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.

17.text: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.

18.text: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.

19.text: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.

20.text: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.

21.text: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.” John’s Testimony about Jesus
